Historical full-card image of [[Sai'torr Kal Fas (V) (Virtual Set 1) (Errata 2)|Sai'torr Kal Fas]], matching the later [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.

== Source ==
* Recovered Holotable image: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/billbisco/swccg-holotable/033d17f68e6ac51848323d353216a685f920f575/historical-recovery/419/large-v17/cards/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/saitorrkalfas.gif exact distribution member].
* Publisher slip and card text: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153847/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards1.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards1.pdf, page 2, card 06], Players Committee; official text as of 4 December 2006 (Internet Archive, 24 October 2007).
* Distribution member: <code>cards/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/saitorrkalfas.gif</code>.
